segments.text: Gummy eats a fried egg, then lets out a fart.
The smell fills the room in an instant.
But most fart gas actually has no smell at all.
It's mostly odorless gas, like nitrogen and carbon dioxide.
Gut bacteria break down food and make a tiny bit of sulfur compound.
Even a trace of that sulfur is strong enough for a nose to catch.
So that small amount of sulfur decides how a fart smells.
